answer: A sybil needs identities that do not look bought, so make every identity pay a real cost up front: lock actual tokens as jade-tinged collateral, not a free signup. When several accounts mirror the same behavior inside one tide of activity, the network flags the cluster and burns the stake. Attacker spinning a thousand fake agents now risks the full bond on each one, which turns a cheap army into a bet he cannot spread. The honest agent pays once and behaves, so the burn never touches him.
